# netbox_device_bay_template (Data Source)

A device bay template of a device type (dcim.devicebaytemplate).

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/models/dcim/devicebaytemplate/):

> A template for a device bay that will be created on all instantiations of the parent device type.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_device_bay_template" "test" {
  name = "test-device_bay_template"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `name` (String)
- `name_contains` (String) Case-insensitive substring of the name.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `device_type_id` (Number) Id of the device type. Device bays only exist on device types, not on module types.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the device bay is enabled.
- `label` (String) Physical label.
- `last_updated` (String)
- `url` (String)
